skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain specific issues related to Management Information Systems.

Implement certain stages of the analysis, design, development, operation, and management process for information systems supporting operational activities, management, and control in organizations and businesses.
Manage time and resources effectively, be adaptable to changes, and communicate well on digital platforms.
Write reports and deliver professional presentations related to plans, strategies, and execution of assigned activities.
Develop skills in analyzing, designing, operating, and managing information systems within organizations and businesses.
Possess the ability to independently seek out and read specialized literature.
Be capable of working independently or actively participating in group activities.
Adhere to laws and regulations of the organization.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Management Information Systems.
